mathematics.general_connectivity: In a finite cubic simple graph with cyclic edge-connectivity at least four, a vertex side with at most six outgoing darts, more than two vertices, and a cycle in its complement is connected. No distinct endpoints, embedding or colouring premise.
mathematics.component_count: A nonempty component opposite a cycle has at least three outgoing edges. If it contains an edge, it has at least four. Cubic incidence forces an internal edge on a side of more than two vertices behind at most six ports.
mathematics.spherical_bound: Every spherical cubic rotation map with at least five distinct edges on every actual quotient face has at least twenty vertices. Repeated facial edge visits are allowed.
mathematics.actual_patch: Exact OpenTangleIsomorphism.Iso from the literal sixteen-vertex six-port patch to an actual vertex shore; no colouring field.
mathematics.patch_cycle: Derived from connectedness and the cubic/tree count; sixteen vertices with six ports cannot be a tree.
mathematics.minimality_consumer: Graph-backed vertex minimality supplies minimum face size and cyclic-four connectivity, exterior connectedness, the smaller colouring and ambient geometry. The six ports supply an exterior root.
